channel.title: Live: MOTD FIFA World Cup 2026
channel.desc: Live coverage as South Africa play their final Group A game against South Korea in Monterrey. South Africa last played at a World Cup as the host nation in 2010, and they're yet to make it past the group stage in three previous attempts. It's been 24 years since South Korea reached the semi-finals on home soil in 2002. They've made it to the round of 16 on two occasions since, including Qatar 2022, where they claimed a dramatic last-gasp win over Portugal in their final group game.
